# gl_test case 54 (es3chain), phase B pass 1: a cube-map face texture of
# GL_RGBA16F as the colour target (GLES_SURF_RGBA16F), cleared blue
# (0, 0, 1, 1) and drawn with a uniform-colour quad, no blending. NOT a dump:
# no drm-shim was available (docs/notes/mali-frame-formats.md section 1).
# Derived from Mesa 26.2.1's source. Settled by the board Mesa reference
# (mode f16rt, tools/mali/board-dump/f16rt-2026-10-24.txt, which
# src/mali/frame_formats_tests.rs reads): two rows differ and are corrected
# below (marked "board:"); every other line held.
#
# Source: pan_format.c:117-121 BFMT_FLOAT(R16G16B16A16_FLOAT, RGBA16F)
#           = { internal RGBA16F, writeback FLOAT_COLOR_FORMAT_RGBA16F,
#               blend { MALI_BLEND_RGBA16F, MALI_BLEND_RGBA16F } } (v9+)
#         pan_desc.c:677-714 get_rt_formats (blendable: internal/writeback
#           from the table, swizzle = inverted format swizzle = RGBA identity)
#         pan_format.h:127-139 pan_format_tib_size (float: raw, 8 bytes)
#         pan_clear.c:102-113, 61-100 pan_pack_color -> pan_pack_raw (float)
#         pan_cmdstream.c:386-396 (blend descriptor, v10: no register_format)
#
# RGB Render Target (src/mali genxml RgbRenderTarget field)      value
#   internal_format       board: ColorBufferInternalFormat::RAW64  0x23
#                         (derived: RGBA16F 0x12)
#   writeback_format      board: ColorFormat::RAW64 (bits 35..39)    5
#                         (derived: writeback_float_format RGBA16F 0x13)
#   write_enable          true
#   writeback_block_format Linear       (as the RGBA8 target, PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear)
#   writeback_msaa        Single
#   srgb                  false
#   dithering_enable      true (unconditional, pan_desc.c:1032)
#   swizzle               RGBA identity  = 0 | 1<<3 | 2<<6 | 3<<9 = 0x688
#   clear (blue)          pan_pack_raw: util_pack_color to 4 halves, 8 bytes,
#                         then copied twice:
#                         color_0 0x00000000  color_1 0x3C003C00
#                         color_2 0x00000000  color_3 0x3C003C00
#                         (R=0 G=0 | B=1.0 A=1.0 in fp16 = 0x3C00)
# Blend descriptor (opaque, blend off)
#   memory_format         Format::RGBA16F << 12 | RgbComponentOrder::RGBA
#                         = 0xDF << 12 = 0xDF000
#   round_to_fb_precision !dithered (GL_DITHER on: false), srgb false
# Framebuffer descriptor
#   tile buffer 8 bytes a sample: tile = (16384 >> 3 = 2048) min 1024 = 1024
#   pixels, colour buffer allocation = 8 * 1024 = 8192 bytes (RGBA8:
#   4 * 1024 = 4096; src/mali frame.rs tile_size takes the bytes a sample
#   from TargetFormat::tib_bytes, which the f16rt frames of the board dump pin)
# Fragment shader: for a blendable target on v9+ the draw's shader does not
# depend on the render target format (pan_shader.c:173-176, 335-350 are
# arch <= 5 only); the bytes should equal case 54's RGBA8 draws'.
# Row stride of a 128x128 face: 128 * 8 = 1024 bytes (board: the 4x4 face
# is 64, a row padded to 64 bytes, not 32).
